scope.linkageReview: All manifests, named-reference scan of shipped Markdown, focused semantic review of flagged routes/prerequisites and seven possible zero-dependency hubs. Not a full technical review of every catalog skill.

method.resolver: Repository Resolver with an in-memory source exposing the current version of each manifest; resolve each of 305 roots independently, including required and available optional dependencies.
method.configuration: No install, agent detection or real configuration writes.
method.referenceLimit: Known-name matches require semantic classification; ordinary terms, local filenames and external titles are not automatic dependencies. Supplemental fenced, case-insensitive and single-word review found additional handoffs.
method.publication: Versions checked against committed index by npm run check:versions; unpublished packages retain initial/already assigned version.

excludedCandidates.reason: Measurement caveat names the statistical phenomenon, not a skill handoff.
